title: Streaming Deep Reinforcement Learning Finally Works
abstract: arXiv:2410.14606v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Learning from a stream of experience as it arrives, also known as streaming learning, is a core part of natural learning. However, reliable streaming learning has remained a persistent challenge in modern deep reinforcement learning (RL). Instead, most deep RL algorithms learn from old experience by storing past interactions in a buffer. We show that both classical streaming RL, such as Q-learning and actor-critic, when used with deep neural networks, and batch deep RL, such as PPO, SAC, and DQN, when adapted to the streaming setting, often fail to learn. Across 58 Atari games and 50 continuous-control tasks, we find that these methods, in aggregate, perform close to random policies despite extensive task-specific hyperparameter searches. translated_title: 流式深度强化学习终于奏效了
translated_abstract: 从不断到达的经验流中学习，也称为流式学习，是自然学习的核心组成部分。然而，可靠的流式学习一直是现代深度强化学习（RL）中一个长期存在的挑战。相反，大多数深度RL算法通过将过去的交互存储在缓冲区中来从旧经验中学习。我们表明，无论是与深度神经网络结合使用的经典流式RL方法（如Q-learning和actor-critic），还是被适配到流式设置下的批量深度RL方法（如PPO、SAC和DQN），通常都无法有效学习。在58个Atari游戏和50个连续控制任务上，我们发现尽管进行了大量针对任务的超参数搜索，这些方法总体上的表现接近随机策略。我们将这种现象称为“流障碍”。在本文中，我们提出了Stream-X，这是一种适用于流式深度RL算法的通用配方，它结合了信号归一化、表示稳定化和受控参数更新等技术。
tldr: 本文提出Stream-X通用配方，通过结合信号归一化、表示稳定化和受控参数更新技术，首次使流式深度强化学习在Atari游戏和连续控制任务上实现可靠学习，突破了长期存在的“流障碍”问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Stream-X, a shared recipe combining signal normalization, representation stabilization, and controlled parameter updates, which finally enables streaming deep RL to learn reliably across Atari games and continuous-control tasks, overcoming the long-standing "stream barrier."
